description: Programming in Python from the first print statement to objects, files, graphics, networked clients and event-driven GUIs, with a working program every week. Taught to the depth of a leading introductory programming course in Python.
modelledOn: Lambert, Fundamentals of Python: First Programs
Guttag, Introduction to Computation and Programming Using Python
outcomes: Write Python programs that use expressions, control structures and functions correctly and idiomatically.
Process text, lists, dictionaries and files to solve information-processing tasks.
Choose and implement simple algorithms and reason about their running time.
Design classes with attributes, methods, inheritance and special methods.
Manipulate images and draw graphics programmatically.
Build a networked client and an event-driven graphical interface.

units.title: Python and programming fundamentals
topics: The interpreter, the shell and scripts; installing Python and an editor
Values, types (int, float, str, bool), variables, assignment, expressions and operators
Input and output; f-strings and formatting
Modules and the standard library: math, random, time
Pythonic style: PEP 8, naming, comments and docstrings

units.title: Control structures and functions
topics: if, elif, else; Boolean logic and truthiness
while and for loops; range; break, continue, else on loops
Defining functions, parameters, default and keyword arguments, return values, scope
Recursion: factorial, Fibonacci, binary search, drawing a Sierpinski triangle
Exceptions: try, except, finally, raise; validating user input

units.title: Strings, text files, lists and dictionaries
topics: String indexing, slicing, methods, immutability; Unicode and encoding
Lists: methods, slicing, nested lists, list comprehensions; tuples
Dictionaries and sets: counting words, lookup tables, grouping
Reading and writing text files; CSV and JSON; processing a file of exam results or sales records
Mutability, aliasing and copying

units.title: Algorithms and information processing
topics: Linear and binary search; selection, insertion and merge sort; using sorted with keys
Counting steps and big-O informally; timing with time and timeit
Simple data analysis: mean, median, mode, histograms from a data file
Regular expressions for extracting phone numbers and dates
Command-line programs with arguments

units.title: Objects and classes
topics: Classes, __init__, attributes, methods, self
Special methods: __str__, __repr__, __eq__, __lt__, operator overloading
Inheritance, polymorphism, super; composition versus inheritance
Data structures as classes: a stack, a queue, a linked list, a bank account
Modules, packages and unit testing with unittest or pytest

units.title: Graphics and image processing
topics: Turtle graphics: coordinates, shapes, recursion for fractals
Images as grids of pixels; loading and saving images with Pillow
Grayscale, invert, brightness, blur, edge detection as loops over pixels
Drawing charts without a library; introduction to matplotlib

units.title: Networks and client/server programming
topics: Sockets: IP addresses, ports, TCP; a simple echo client and server
HTTP from Python: urllib and requests; fetching a web page and a JSON API
Parsing HTML and JSON responses; a weather or exchange-rate client
Building a small chat application; blocking calls and threads

units.title: Graphical user interfaces
topics: tkinter windows, widgets, labels, buttons, entries, text boxes
Layout managers: pack, grid; frames and canvases
Model-view separation: keeping logic out of the GUI
A temperature converter and a to-do list application

units.title: Events and event-driven programming
topics: The event loop; callbacks and command bindings
Mouse and keyboard events; timers with after
A simple drawing program and a small game on a canvas
Project: an event-driven application with files, classes and a GUI
